params.name: Sections
params.note: Sent as JSON text ([{ tag, title, open, lines, columns, rows, code }]); the gallery frame draws it in the Details drawer as text. PkGallerySection.ForBlazor() is the Blazor section, computed from the package's mappings.

notes: New component, no Blazor equivalent. Needs the SDK dist folder served with the app so embed.html is reachable.
